meta.name: add-imessage
meta.description: Add iMessage to NanoClaw — one channel, two backends. Local (this Mac's chat.db via the Chat SDK bridge; macOS + Full Disk Access) or Hosted iMessage (via photon.codes — native spectrum-ts with a device-login wizard; any OS, no Mac relay). Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", "imessage via photon", "native imessage".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 NanoClaw 连接 iMessage 通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在使用 NanoClaw 并希望接收 iMessage 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect iMessage to NanoClaw as a channel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and want to receive iMessage messages.

howto.what: 为 NanoClaw 加装 iMessage 渠道：从 channels 分支复制适配器、注册并安装 chat-adapter-imessage、构建并跑注册测试、重启服务，再解析你发消息用的号码或邮箱。
howto.when: 当你说出 “add imessage”、“connect imessage”、“add photon” 等触发词，或要求接入 iMessage 渠道时触发；原文写明本机模式只在 macOS 上可用。

say.text: 帮我加上 iMessage 渠道，选本机模式
say.note: 会让你授权 Node 的完全磁盘访问权限

say.text: iMessage 走 Photon 远程模式接入
say.note: 会要你填 Photon 服务器 URL 和 API key
把它设为对接的会话地址

howto.what_en: Adds an iMessage channel to NanoClaw: copies the adapter from the `channels` branch, registers it, installs chat-adapter-imessage, builds and runs the registration test, restarts the service, and resolves your iMessage handle.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", etc., or any request to wire up iMessage. Local mode only runs on macOS.

say_en.text: Add the iMessage channel in local mode
say_en.note: It asks you to grant Full Disk Access to Node

say_en.text: Connect iMessage via remote Photon mode
say_en.note: It asks for your Photon server URL and API key
Sets it as the conversation address to wire
